base_weapons.name: Rusty Shiv
base_weapons.flavor: It's insulting that I'm holding this. But it gets the job done.

base_weapons.name: Iron Claymore
base_weapons.flavor: Finally, something with weight. Compensating for something? Yes. Your incompetence.

base_weapons.name: Bone Whip
base_weapons.flavor: Vertebrae from something that annoyed me. Poetic.

base_weapons.name: Forbidden Tome
base_weapons.flavor: Forbidden to mortals. Bedtime reading for me.

base_weapons.name: Silver Rapier
base_weapons.flavor: Elegant. Precise. Everything you aren't.

base_weapons.name: Acid Vial
base_weapons.flavor: I could dissolve your ambitions with this. And your face.

base_weapons.name: Ember Staff
base_weapons.flavor: Burns at the temperature of my contempt. So, very hot.

base_weapons.name: War Maul
base_weapons.flavor: Subtlety is overrated. This isn't subtle.

base_weapons.name: Spirit Lantern
base_weapons.flavor: It holds a trapped soul. Don't worry, it deserved it.

base_weapons.name: Sonic Bell
base_weapons.flavor: Rings at a frequency that makes lesser beings reconsider existing.

base_weapons.name: Celestial Spear
base_weapons.flavor: Forged from a collapsed star. I was bored that afternoon.

base_weapons.name: Plague Dagger
base_weapons.flavor: Two problems in one blade. Efficient. I approve.

base_weapons.name: Crystal Wand
base_weapons.flavor: It hums with contained power. Try not to drop it. Actually, drop it. See what happens.

base_weapons.name: Thunder Maul
base_weapons.flavor: Hits hard. Hits loud. The sound is part of the point.

base_weapons.name: Shadow Blade
base_weapons.flavor: Cuts through shapeshifters and lies equally well.

base_weapons.name: Frost Lance
base_weapons.flavor: Cold enough to make even constructs pause. Briefly.

base_weapons.name: Blessed Gauntlets
base_weapons.flavor: Punching with the authority of a Goddess. Which is me. Obviously.

base_weapons.name: Barbed Chain
base_weapons.flavor: Every link is a promise. Every promise draws blood.

base_weapons.name: Moonfire Bow
base_weapons.flavor: Burns silver-hot. Werewolves find this particularly unpleasant.

base_weapons.name: Void Shard
base_weapons.flavor: A piece of nothing, weaponized. I thought of it. You're welcome.
